screens.name: 01-play
screens.note: The board, part-way through, with the hint armed. The promise made visible: the level was solved before it was served, and the arrows are the next move of that solution.

screens.name: 02-progress
screens.note: The daily puzzle everyone gets, the streak it feeds and the month behind it.

screens.name: 03-packs

screens.name: 04-accessible
screens.note: The color-blind palette with a shape on every unit. Needs -pro, because it is part of the unlock.

screens.name: 05-paywall
screens.note: Needs -fakeProducts: a scheme's StoreKit configuration is never honoured by a simctl launch, so the real product is unavailable and the button would sit disabled.
